# MeshTransit

> Zero Trust access to private infrastructure: control plane (core/), relay
> (relay/), node daemon and CLI (client/).

## Read first

- README.md: layout, build and licensing
- AGENTS.md: repository-wide rules for coding agents
- core/AGENTS.md, core/README.md: control plane
- client/AGENTS.md, client/README.md: meshd, meshnetd, meshcred, meshctl
- docs/README.md: documentation index; docs/glossary.md: terms
- docs/architecture/: overview, Core, client and relay architecture
- docs/clients/: installing the client per platform, client security model
- docs/operations/: configuring, deploying, upgrading and monitoring
- docs/protocol/: protocol specifications (MTCP, MTRP, disco, audit records)
- docs/core/: Core design notes
